newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: M.HILL SAME-STORE SALES EDGE UP IN 1996/97.
newsitem.headline: M.HILL SAME-STORE SALES EDGE UP IN 1996/97.

text.p: New Zealand-based jewellery manufacturer and retailer Michael Hill International Ltd said on Tuesday its overall same-store sales rose by 1.3 percent during the year ended June 30, 1997.

In a statement accompanying its results for the year it said "revenue from same stores, as in the previous year, rose 1.3 percent during the year with total revenue, including one new store opened during the period, rising 6.7 percent."
For Australia, where it had 52 stores at the end of the reporting period comared with 47 a year before, Michael Hill said same-store revenue rose by 1.8 percent.
It plans to open six further stores in Australia in 1997/98 subject to site acquisition and cost.
